g.text: Backend ready. Ctrl+A add a file, Ctrl+R re-index, then ask questions.
> At what temperature and for how long do I bake Nonna Rosa's lasagna?
Bake it at 190 degrees Celsius for 45 minutes, until the top is golden and the
edges bubble. Let it rest for 15 minutes before cutting.
sk about your files... (Enter to send)
